title: Repeated Rh(D) antibody testing for unsensitized Rh(D)-negative pregnant women at 24-28 weeks' gestation

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends repeated Rh(D) antibody testing for all unsensitized Rh(D)-negative women at 24 to 28 weeks' gestation, unless the biological father is known to be Rh(D)-negative.

action: Perform repeat Rh(D) antibody testing at 24 to 28 weeks' gestation
